items.text: Final report: Washington is without QB Marcus Mariota, RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin), OLB Javontae Jean-Baptiste and DE Charles Omenihu. Jayden Daniels starts.

Game-time decision: WR Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is questionable after missing last week, DNP Thursday and limited Friday/Saturday; status confirmed with inactives 90 minutes before kickoff. DT Javon Kinlaw and S Percy Butler and Tyler Owens are also questionable.

San Francisco is without DE Nick Bosa (calf), WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring), S Marques Sigle and LB Garret Wallow; LB Dre Greenlaw serves a one-game suspension. DL Mykel Williams and Gracen Halton are questionable.
WR Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) is questionable but Adam Schefter expects him to play; WR Christian Kirk (calf, IR return) is questionable for his 2026 debut and his activation may depend on Evans.

adjust.reason: San Francisco loses Nick Bosa, Dre Greenlaw (suspended), Deebo Samuel and two more defensive starters, more than Washington's two missing edge rushers, RB and a questionable Stefon Diggs. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
